### Caption Function
 social_caption <- function(
            linkedin="johnmichaelgraham",
            github="johngrhm6",
            bluesky="johngrhm",
            icon_color = "black",
            font_color = "black",
            font_family = "sans") {
  
  icons_df <- data.frame(
        icons = c("", "", ""),
        socials = c(linkedin, bluesky, github)
  )
  icons_df <- na.omit(icons_df)
  
  glue_icon <- function(icon,social){
    glue::glue(
      "<span style='font-family:\"Font Awesome 7\"; 
      color:{icon_color};'>{icon} </span>  <span style='font-family:{font_family}; 
      color:{font_color};'>{social} </span> "
    )
  }

  # Map over all icons
  caption <- purrr::map2(
    .x = icons_df$icons,
    .y = icons_df$socials,
    .f = ~glue_icon(.x, .y)
  ) |> 
    purrr::as_vector() |> 
    stringr::str_flatten()

  return(caption)
}

social <- social_caption(
  icon_color = highlight_col,
  font_color = text_col,
  font_family = body_font
)
```


Data Wrangling

Show Code```{r}
tt_data <- tt_load(2026, week=2)

africa <- tt_data$africa

africa_sf <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium",continent = "Africa")

africa_families <- africa |> 
  group_by(country) |> 
  mutate(TotalLanguageFamily = n_distinct(family),
         Families = paste(unique(family),collapse = "\n")) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  select(country,TotalLanguageFamily,Families) |> 
  distinct()


africa_families_mapped <- africa_families|> 
  mutate(country = case_match(.x = country,.default = country,
    "Ivory Coast"~"Côte d'Ivoire",
    "Central African Republic"~"Central African Rep.",
    "South Sudan"~"S. Sudan",
    "Equatorial Guinea"~"Eq. Guinea",
    "Cape Verde"~"Cabo Verde",
    "Eswatini"~"eSwatini",
  )) |> 
  right_join(africa_sf |> select(name),by=c("country"="name")) 
```


Plot

Show Code```{r fig.height= 7,fig.width=10}
subtitle <- glue("There are over <span style='color:{highlight_col}'>**{n_distinct(africa$family)}**</span> distinct language families across the continent of Africa")

map <- africa_families_mapped |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_sf(aes(geometry=geometry,fill=`TotalLanguageFamily`))+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d9ed92",high = "#34a0a4",na.value = "white")+
  labs(fill = "Language Families",
       subtitle = subtitle,
       caption = social)+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)+
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white",colour = "white"),
        plot.margin=margin(2,2,2,2,unit = "cm"),
        plot.caption = element_textbox_simple(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.subtitle = element_textbox_simple(colour = family_colours[8],hjust = 0.5,
                                        lineheight = 0.5,face = "bold",
                                        size = 16),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white",colour = "white"))



bar <- africa_families |> 
  group_by(TotalLanguageFamily) |> 
  summarise(n=n()) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=factor(TotalLanguageFamily),y=n,fill=TotalLanguageFamily))+
  geom_col(width = 0.6)+
  geom_text(aes(label=n))+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d9ed92",high = "#34a0a4",na.value = "white")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1 family","2 families","3 families","4 families","5 families"))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.2,0))+
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
        legend.position = "none",panel.grid = element_blank()
        )



p <- map+inset_element(bar,left = 0.2,right = 0.5,top = 0.5,bottom = 0.3,align_to = "full")

p

Data Wrangling & Plot

Show Code```{r}
capital_concentration <- companies_raw |> 
  arrange(desc(capital_stock)) |> 
  mutate(comp_pct = row_number()/n(),
         capital_stock_pct =cumsum(capital_stock)/sum(capital_stock))


annotations <- capital_concentration |> 
  summarise(top_1 = capital_stock_pct[ceiling(n()*.01)],
            top10 = capital_stock_pct[ceiling(n()*0.1)],
            companies_90 = min(which(capital_stock_pct>=0.9))
            )
  

companies_raw |> 
  arrange(desc(capital_stock)) |> 
  mutate(company_pct = row_number()/n(),
         capital_stock_pct = cumsum(capital_stock)/sum(capital_stock)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0,slope = 1,linetype = 'dashed',colour = 'grey')+
  geom_line(aes(y=company_pct,
                x=capital_stock_pct))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(y=company_pct,
                x=capital_stock_pct,
                ymin = company_pct,
                ymax = capital_stock_pct),fill='#2a9d8f',alpha = 0.3)+
  labs(title = "**Lorenz curve of Brazillian Companies**",
       x="Cumulative Capital %",
       y="Cumlative Company %")+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent,breaks = seq(0,1,0.2))+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,breaks = seq(0,1,0.2))+
  annotate(geom = 'text',x=0.8,y=0.99,
           size=3,
           colour ="#2a9d8f",
           label=str_wrap("Top 1% of companies control over 99% of the capital market",width = 20))+
  coord_equal()+
  theme_minimal(base_family = f1)+
  theme(plot.title = element_textbox_simple(halign = 0.5,colour ="#bc4749",margin = margin(t=0,b=30)),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(margin(5,10,5,10)),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill="#fefae0",colour = "#fefae0"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill="#fefae0",colour = "#fefae0")
        )

Tidy Data

Show Code```{r}
cleaned_data <- edible_plants_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(temperature_growing)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(temperature_germination)) |> 
  select(cultivation,temperature_growing,temperature_germination) |> 
  separate_wider_delim(temperature_growing,delim = "-",
                       names = c("min_temp_grow","max_temp_grow"),too_few = "align_start") |> 
  separate_wider_delim(temperature_germination,delim = "-",names = c("min_temp_germination","max_temp_germination"),too_few = "align_start") |> 
  mutate(max_temp_germination = ifelse(is.na(max_temp_germination),
                                       min_temp_germination,max_temp_germination),
         max_temp_grow = ifelse(is.na(max_temp_grow)|max_temp_grow=="",min_temp_grow,max_temp_grow)) |> 
  filter(cultivation!="Miscellaneous") |> 
  mutate(cultivation = ifelse(cultivation=="Solanum","Solanaceae",cultivation)) |> 
  group_by(cultivation) |> 
  summarise(ave_min_temp_grow = mean(as.numeric(min_temp_grow)),
            ave_max_temp_grow = mean(as.numeric(max_temp_grow)),
            ave_min_temp_germ = mean(as.numeric(min_temp_germination)),
            ave_max_temp_germ = mean(as.numeric(max_temp_germination)),
            range_temp_grow = ave_max_temp_grow - ave_min_temp_grow,
            range_temp_germ = ave_max_temp_germ - ave_min_temp_germ,
            sample_size = n()
            ) |> 
  mutate(id = row_number())
